notice.en: Built-in drafting knowledge of Qiyas. Mizan draws a full package without being told how seniors draw. Qiyas draws; loads, design calculations and approval belong to the engineer and the company. Every sheet says For review. All thresholds are editable practice defaults unless a code is named.
notice.ar: معرفة الرسم المدمجة في قياس. ميزان يرسم حزمة كاملة دون أن يُطلب منه كيف يرسم كبار المهندسين. قياس يرسم؛ الأحمال والحسابات التصميمية والاعتماد من مسؤولية المهندس والشركة. كل لوحة مكتوب عليها: للمراجعة. كل الحدود قيم ممارسة معتادة قابلة للتعديل ما لم يُذكر كود.

door.note: A leaf line at its open position plus the swing arc. Two leaves for openings from double_leaf_from_m wide.

double_leaf_from_m.rationale: A leaf wider than about 1.0 m is hard to swing; wide villa entrances are double leaf. Practice, not a code value.

cut_height_m.rationale: The plan cuts the stair about 1.2 m above the floor; the treads above the cut are drawn dashed. Practice.

going_m.rationale: Comfortable tread used when a code minimum is smaller. Practice.

handrail_offset_m.rationale: Drawn inside the flight edge. Practice.

gap_between_flights_m.rationale: Eye between the two flights of a U stair. Practice.

foundation_level.label_en: Foundation level (indicative, by the structural engineer)

circulation_share_warn.rationale: Corridors and halls take about 10 to 15 percent of a house floor. Above 15 percent the plan is carrying too much passage.

circulation_share_error.rationale: A fifth of the floor is passage: the plan needs to be reorganised, not adjusted.

corridor_length_max_m.rationale: A passage longer than this is a corridor plan with rooms on both sides. Practice.

kitchen_to_living_max_ratio.rationale: The kitchen is not larger than the biggest living space of its floor. Practice.

master_rule_min_bedrooms.rationale: From three bedrooms a villa has a master bedroom with its own bathroom. Practice.

baths_per_bedroom_min.rationale: A villa with four bedrooms and two shared bathrooms is under-served; three or more is the usual minimum. Practice.

guest_wc_distance_max_m.rationale: Guests reach the WC without crossing the family area. Practice.

bedroom_oversize_m2.rationale: A bedroom other than the master above this size is wasting floor. Practice.

master_oversize_m2.rationale: A master bedroom without dressing and bath above this size is wasting floor. Practice.

service_oversize_m2.rationale: Utility, laundry and store above this size are wasting floor. Practice.
